S2.core: genuine policy-gradient optimization on large complex parent scenes
S2.episodes: 50% full10x10 tasks,50% local windows balanced4x3/6x6/8x8, all embedded in original10x10 geometry/navigation
S2.task_and_constraints: Sample declared parent/task bank only, A_condition=(parent_index+task_draw_index)%3 using frozen make_allow; unchanged proxy F and base footprint. Whole-parent task density/obstacles/F&A remain visible.
S2.windows_and_endpoints: Full episodes closed depot; local size cyclic4x3/6x6/8x8, x0/y0 uniformly drawn among valid table-grid origins from sampling RNG. Alternate closed depot and open first/last depot-connected global candidates by local episode index.
S2.schedule: even update indexes full; odd local sizes cyclic; four parent/task draws from fixed sampling seed; same instance3 trajectories: one fully policy-sampled including first action plus2 forced distinct legal first stops
S2.starts: Primary trajectory samples first action with logprob; auxiliary forced starts are first/last legal original IDs and contribute no forced-first logprob. All complete same target tasks; no TSP symmetry claim.
S2.loss: For each trajectory use detached leave-one-out mean return of the other2 as baseline. Negative advantage*logprob: primary weight1, each forced auxiliary weight.25, divide total by1.5. S0 forced-only probe checks plumbing, not this future optimizer.
S2.objective: REINFORCE on negative complete JH with exact masks and explicit entry/exit; no teacher action-regression substitute
S2.optimizer: Adam1e-4,clip1,512 fixed updates,batch4instances,3 optimizer seeds11622026..28; save fixed end, no S3 selection
S2.controls: frozen_SL same S1 weight; continuedSL fresh Adam512 on same frozen S1 teacher pool, same CE/batch4, independent phase sampling. This compares training pipelines, not equal-FLOPs or pure algorithm causality.
S2.development: 18 declared local cases on3 separate parent layouts, checked at updates256 and512 for feasibility/resources only; no best-checkpoint selection and no S3 reads
S2.missing_reward: Failures charged; do not silently discard/reward-zero infeasible routes; stop incomplete. No new seed/epoch rescue.
S2.boundary: Training and controls remain supervised+RL distinction; final contribution requires positive independent RL increment, not merely smaller degradation.
S2.parent_modes: mixed/blocked alternating,48 each, declared96 geometry labels pending canonical identity audit
S2.forward_backward_execution: Macro batch4, fixed weights throughout batch; accumulate gradient of instance_loss/4 separately, clip once after4, optimizer.step once. This matches batch-mean objective; before formal use require synthetic value/gradient equivalence regression. Separate prefix caches across3 trajectories; rebuild encodings after any weight update.
S2.mixed_objective: Preserve v2 weighted mixture [E_primary R+.25E_forcedlow R+.25E_forcedhigh R]/1.5 with R=-JH. Primary includes first logprob; forced auxiliary starts do not. Each row baseline detached mean of other2 independent returns.

boundaries.empty_instance: Legal direct entry->exit terminal, zero logprob/loss contribution, still record cost; never replace sample.
boundaries.all_empty_macro_batch: Inconclusive stop before optimizer; do not resample to force512steps.
boundaries.one_legal_first: Both auxiliary roles use the only legal first node, independent suffix generators; retain .25/.25 weights and record unique_first=1, no silent dedup reweight.
boundaries.zero_advantage_nonempty: Keep registered update schedule, record zero-signal batch, no extra entropy/teacher/round; optimizer step with computed zero grads is recorded.
boundaries.invalid_or_nonfinite: Pre-debit work, preserve failure, stop inconclusive; no reward-zero pseudo-success or replacement.

S2.memory_execution: Use fixed instance gradient accumulation to avoid holding12full-episode graphs simultaneously. Bounded navigation cache max2parent maps; task-conditioned neural cache per episode and bound to task/F/A/D/weights. Before first optimizer validate actual batch4-equivalent memory and gradients; no automatic batch/scale/budget change.

S3.inference: One greedy rollout per actor, no teacher/extra starts; deterministic weights/input/thread controls. Report cold/hot navigation scope equally across methods; parsing/array loading/subset/all encodings/H/export/validation included, IO/model load separately clear.

S3.independent_RL_gate: ALL valid; vs frozen SL and continued-SL mean paired gain>=.5% with parent-cluster bootstrap95 lower>0, each size reported; three optimizer seeds direction consistent; no use of action Top1 as final success
S3.deployment_gate: vs Detour16 mean relative degradation one-sided95upper<=.5%; complete median time ratio<=.7 and p95<=1 in both cache modes; not dominated byFixed3; report seen/unseen and each size separately
S3.bootstrap: 20000 parent-cluster resamples seed11632026; independent parents6 seen/12 unseen, NOT108 independent environments
S3.no_blending: Report raw/H gains separately, no teacher search at inference, no returned-home/exit connection cost omission

S3.primary_decision: Global target supported only if all6 group x size cells meet both independent-RL-control criteria and all12 group x size x cache deployment strata meet deployment requirements. Otherwise retain per-cell successes with limited scope, no pooled rescue.
S3.quality_aggregation: For each group,size,method, first mean the2endpoint child costs per parent per seed; then mean3optimizer-seed parent values. Compute relative gain from parent method means; equal parent weight. Bootstrap parent clusters20000 with registered seed.
S3.RL_gate_per_cell: For both frozenSL and continuedSL: mean paired parent-relative cost reduction>=.5%, percentile95 lower>0, each of3seed point gains positive, ALL cases valid. FrozenSL comparisons use same seed lineage. All6cells required for overall claim.
S3.deployment_gate_per_stratum: Detour relative quality degradation one-sided95upper<=.5% using parent aggregation; complete raw request median ratio<=.7,p95 ratio<=1 for each(group,size,cache); not Pareto dominated byFixed3 in meanJ/median/p95. All strata required for overall deployment claim.
S3.timing_aggregation: Within each group,size,cache, pool all parent x endpoint x seed x3repeat request timings for descriptive median/p95. Quality uses parent units, not request count. Endpoint-specific tables always reported; no causal endpoint/position comparison.
